title: Accelerating ab initio melting property calculations with machine learning: application to the high entropy alloy TaVCrW

recollection.mechanism: utilization of machine learning to predict melting properties

score.note: The recollection only restates the title-level use of machine learning and misses the specific MTP-for-liquid and FEP-for-TI substitutions.
